title: Backup and Restore
summary: Export everything to a single file — take it anywhere, restore anytime.

cards.heading: What Backup does
cards.body: Backup packs every note, template, setting, and attachment into one .json file. Nothing leaves your device unless you share the file yourself.

cards.heading: Exporting a backup
cards.body: Tap **Export Backup**. Iron Rabbit builds the file and hands it to your device's share sheet — save to Files, email it, or drop it into your cloud.

cards.heading: Restoring from a backup
cards.body: Tap **Import Backup** and pick the .json file. Choose **Merge** to add on top of what you have, or **Replace** to wipe and reload.

cards.heading: Tip: Back up before big changes
cards.body: **Tip:** Export a backup before enabling PIN lock, changing themes drastically, or clearing data. Two seconds now saves an hour of regret later.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Replace wipes everything currently on the device. If you're unsure, use Merge — it will overwrite by ID but keep anything the backup doesn't mention.
